statement: Fuel shortages around Abéché force aid convoys to cut deliveries to refugee sites in eastern Chad
why: Truck operators I speak to are already rationing fuel, and prices moved again in the last two weeks.

statement: Cholera spreads through displacement sites around Tawila as water points fail
why: Clinics report more cases of watery diarrhoea, and water trucking has slowed since the last attacks.

statement: Flooding along the Niger river cuts farmers in Tillabéri off from their markets
why: The river is higher than usual for November and two local roads are already closed.

statement: Fuel import limits at Hodeidah push up the price of trucked water in northern Yemen
why: Water trucking depends on diesel. Households are already paying more for less.

statement: Ethiopia's rains end early and harm the next harvest
why: Farmers are worried about the season.
